decisions.reason: The carpet has kept its own page in both years, a visible commitment within a collection the firm keeps investing in, and there is no sign of withdrawal, so management will persist with it.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a high-investment premium piece that still has its own page, and its sunk development costs and showcase role make management reluctant to drop it.

The corner bench lost its own page in 2024, but the firm still publicly promotes it as a new interpretation of a classic, and that announced design commitment encourages persistence despite the weaker exposure.
The low-pile carpet is still presented on its own page, and having already dropped its sibling Product C, management is likely to justify keeping the remaining carpets.
The swivel shell chair keeps its dedicated page, and as a core seating product with tooling and design investments, it fits the firm's central furniture direction.
